file_id: Ashoke Dey & Anr vs The State Of West Bengal & Anr on 31 March, 2026

sentences.text:
Ashoke Dey & Anr vs The State Of West Bengal & Anr on 31
March, 2026
 5.
31-03-2026
(ct. no.34)
 debajyoti
 In The High Court At Calcutta
 Criminal Revisional Jurisdiction
 Crr 129 of 2026
 Ashoke Dey & Anr.
 Vs.
 The State of West Bengal & Anr.
 Mr. Soumyajit Das Mahapatra, Adv.
 ... For the Petitioners.
 1.
The matter has come at the instance of the petitioners since certain typographical errors are crept in.

It is submitted by the learned advocate for the petitioners that in paragraph 1 of the order dated February 26, 2026, the relevant sections quoted are not tallying with the sections mentioned in the petition in the revisional application or the complaint lodged before the court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate.

2. Perused the petition as well as the written complaint and it appears that the sections incorporated in the last line of paragraph of the order dated February 26, 2026 should be Sections 323/354A/354C/420/506/34 of the Indian Penal Code instead of Sections 384/506/406 of the Indian Penal Code.

That apart, in paragraph 3 of the said order, the sentence "the present petitioner no.1 along with his son aged about 64 years and daughter aged about 62 years" should be deleted since the complaint was lodged by the present petitioner no.1 only against the opposite party no.2.
3.
On a careful scrutiny of the records, it also appears that due to inadvertent mistake, this part has been incorporated which needs to be deleted.
Let the above marked portion be deleted from paragraph no.3.
Let this order form part of the order dated February 26, 2026.
The other portion of the said order shall remain unaltered.
4. Concerned department is directed to carry out the above corrections in the order dated February 26, 2026.
5. All parties shall act on the server copies of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.
